diagnosis: The RAG context retrieval endpoint accepts a documentId route parameter and executes a vector similarity search in PostgreSQL using pgvector. It fails to check if the targeted documentId belongs to the authenticated user's organization before returning embedded chunk contents. An attacker can supply document IDs belonging to other enterprises to inspect proprietary contract text and intellectual property.
